raw.details:
This Diwali, turn your ideas into reality!

CodeDia 2026 is an individual AI buildathon where participants get the opportunity to create innovative products using Adaption AI.

Whether you are a student, developer, designer, beginner, or working professional, you are welcome to participate.

There is no fixed theme, no predefined problem statement, and no restriction on what you can build. You can turn any idea into a working product using Adaption AI.

Event Schedule

  • 15 November 2026: Official Opening Ceremony and Buildathon Begins.

  • 15–30 November 2026: Product Building and Project Submission Period.

  • 30 November 2026: Final Submission Deadline.

  • 1 December 2026: Winner Announcement.

Participants can start building their projects and submit them at any time during the event period. All projects must be submitted before the final deadline of 30 November 2026.

How to Participate?

Follow these simple steps:

Step 1 – Register on Unstop

Register for CodeDia 2026 through the official Unstop opportunity.

Step 2 – Create Your Adaption AI Account

Complete the Adaption AI onboarding process:

  • Create a new Adaption AI account..

Step 3 – Join the Opening Ceremony

Join the online opening ceremony on 15 November 2026 to understand the event guidelines, challenge instructions, and project submission process.

Step 4 – Start Building

Start building your product using Adaption AI. You can work on your project at your own pace during the event period.

Step 5 – Submit Your Project

Complete and submit your project anytime before 30 November 2026. Detailed submission instructions and the submission link will be shared with registered participants.

Step 6 – Winner Announcement

The final results and winners will be announced on 1 December 2026 through official Nexus Spring Of Code communication channels.

What Can You Build?

Anything you can imagine!

There is no fixed theme or predefined problem statement. You are free to identify a problem and build your own innovative solution.

Some project ideas include:

  • AI-powered applications and websites.

  • AI automation tools.

  • SaaS products.

  • Productivity tools.

  • Educational platforms.

  • Developer tools.

  • Business solutions.

  • Healthcare and accessibility solutions.

  • Creative AI applications.

  • Real-world problem-solving products.

Your creativity is the only limit!

Eligibility & Event Format

  • Open to everyone, worldwide.

  • Individual participation only.

  • Online participation.

  • Open innovation theme.

  • Flexible project-building period.

  • Meaningful Adaption AI usage is mandatory.

Rules & Guidelines

  • Participants must register through the official Unstop event listing.

  • Every participant must participate individually.

  • Participants are free to use any programming language, framework, library, or additional AI tool.

  • Meaningful use of Adaption AI is mandatory.

  • Projects must be developed during the official event period. Pre-existing complete projects cannot be submitted as newly built projects.

  • Plagiarism, copied projects, and fraudulent submissions are strictly prohibited.

  • Participants can submit their projects anytime before the final deadline of 30 November 2026.

  • Participants must provide accurate project information and demonstrate their Adaption AI integration.

  • The organisers reserve the right to verify submissions and disqualify participants violating the rules.

  • The organisers' decision regarding eligibility, evaluation, and final results will be binding.

Why Participate?

  • Build and showcase a real-world product.

  • Gain practical experience with Adaption AI.

  • Showcase your creativity and technical abilities.

  • Compete for exciting prizes and recognition.

  • Get your project showcased within the NSoC community.

  • Connect with developers and innovators.

About the Organiser

Nexus Spring Of Code (NSoC) is a student-driven open-source initiative focused on encouraging innovation, building developer communities, and providing opportunities for developers to learn, collaborate, and build real-world projects.

Organised by: Nexus Spring Of Code (NSoC)

Technology Partner: Adaption AI

Platform Partner: Unstop

One Idea. One Builder. Unlimited Possibilities.

This Diwali, don't just celebrate innovation. Build it!

Register now for CodeDia 2026!
